fix_under_test.name: D2 = data-driven de-smoothing of the bob1 spoon in the stir window, bob1 spoon MESH and its levelling convention kept
rule: 1. Smoothing residual per frame f (all GT-free, this episode): C(f) = rigid motion from Ken's smoothed spoon pose Ts(f) to his raw FP pose Tr(f) (ken_c_scored/episode_000006/wooden_spoon poses_smoothed/ and poses/, camera frame, wxyz as verified in round 1), expressed in the scene world: rotation vector r(f) about Ken's smoothed centroid p(f), plus centroid displacement d(f). Inputs copied from round-1 d4_rawfp.json rows (Tr, Ts).

2. Flip rejection: frames with |r(f)| > 30 deg (the scorer's MP-SR per-body orientation bound; round-1 N2 roll flips) are rejected and r, d there are linearly interpolated from the nearest accepted frames.
3. De-jitter: Gaussian smoothing of r and d over frames with sigma s, s chosen from {1, 1.5, 2} by step 8.

4. Candidate per frame f in the stir window W = f42-165 (round-1 N1 window): T_ds(f) = C_s(f) applied to bob1's reference pose T_ref(f) (left-multiplied world motion, so bob1's constant body-frame levelling and its mesh are untouched).

5. Per-frame choice by the mask/depth fit: c(f) = 1 if cost(T_ds(f)) < cost(T_ref(f)) else 0, cost = round-1 refine cost 1 - IoU_occ + 0.04*min(|median FS-depth residual cm|, 6) against the SAM 3 spoon mask (hand masks + pot mask as occluders).
6. Weight w(f) = Gaussian(sigma s) smoothing of c over W; ramps: w(42)*(1-j/7) on f42-j and w(165)*(1-j/7) on f165+j for j = 1..6 (f36-41, f166-171); 0 elsewhere.
7. Final pose T_new(f) = weighted correction (w(f)*r_s(f) about p(f), plus w(f)*d_s(f)) applied to T_ref(f); only f36-171 can change.

8. Sigma: among s in {1, 1.5, 2} whose FULL-data track passes G3, the one with the lowest mean held-out cost in the primary parity CV (G1); ties -> larger s. No other free parameter; no per-episode hand-set numbers.

definitions.REST: this mesh's own rest-phase fit: mean IoU_occ of bob1's reference spoon over f0-24 and f220-242 (48 frames), same code, same run (round 1: 0.511 / 0.462, pooled ~0.4875)
definitions.cost / IoU_occ / depth: exactly round-1 diag6.cost_at (fit6 render at 1/2 resolution, SAM 3 masks/1 of wooden_spoon, hand masks 2-3 + pot mask as occluders, FS depth from ken_c_scored white_pot/depth)
definitions.primary parity CV: fold P in {0,1}: the choice c(f) is computed only on W frames with f % 2 == P; on the other frames c is linearly interpolated from those frames, then step 6; evaluated on the held-out frames (every W frame is held out once). The correction C_s itself uses all frames (it is FoundationPose output, an input like the masks, not fitted by us).
definitions.strict parity CV: as primary, but the correction r, d is also taken only from the training-parity frames (others interpolated before smoothing), so nothing from a held-out frame enters its pose.

gates.rationale: mesh-relative replacement of round-1's absolute 0.50 bar (N5: the mesh's own rest fit is ~0.49).
